alerts.name: JP LCR orders at limit up/down
alerts.description: Working Japanese orders with LCR=0.* in their fixmsg whose stock is at its daily limit (B-PIPE MIN_LIMIT / MAX_LIMIT): best bid at the limit up, best ask at the limit down, or the last trade at either. The limits are asked once per stock per day, when a new stock shows up among the orders; bid, ask and last price at every check.

steps.name: jp_orders
steps.note: Today's activated JP parents whose fixmsg has LCR=0.*; code = 7203 from 7203.JP, lcr = the LCR field
steps.raw_q: {[d] t:select date,id_server,id_target,sym,trader,side,size,algo,fixmsg from target where date=d, sym like "*.JP", fixmsg like "*LCR=0.*"; ids:exec distinct id_target from t; s:select state:last state, leave:last leave by date,id_server,id_target from target_state where date=d, id_target in ids; r:select from (t lj s) where state=`activated; update code:`$first each "." vs/: string sym, lcr:`${first x where x like "LCR=*"} each {raze "^" vs/: x} each ";" vs/: string fixmsg from r}[.z.D]

steps.name: limits
steps.note: Daily price limits: asked once per stock per day, only for stocks not seen yet today

steps.name: prices
steps.note: Live bid, ask and last trade, at every check

steps.name: at_limit
steps.note: Up: bid or last at MAX_LIMIT. Down: ask (above 0) or last at MIN_LIMIT

derive.expr: 'UP' if (BID >= MAX_LIMIT or LAST_PRICE >= MAX_LIMIT) else 'DOWN'

steps.where: BID >= MAX_LIMIT or LAST_PRICE >= MAX_LIMIT or (ASK > 0 and ASK <= MIN_LIMIT) or LAST_PRICE <= MIN_LIMIT
